acceptance.given: A success evaluation receives a foreign-authority case.

oracle.expected: The case receives a non-success result.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a foreign-authority case.
oracle.observable: The success-evaluation decision records rejection of the foreign-authority case.

acceptance.when: The Toolchain semantic gate evaluates a foreign-authority case for success.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Present a foreign-authority case to success evaluation and assert that no success decision is emitted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Fail closed when a foreign-authority case is offered as support for a success decision.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing non-success terminal categories and foreign-authority rejection semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Foreign-authority case presented for success -> success rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A foreign-authority case cannot yield a success result.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has succeeded and carries its bound Consumer identity and execution inputs.

oracle.expected: A distinct Consumer-verification record independently binds the Consumer's actual interface, invocation, input, command, output, result, and dependencies to the successful Replay Result.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result that lacks independent Consumer verification.
Treating a self-reported Consumer label or an unexecuted route as Consumer verification.
oracle.observable: The replay receipt's independently generated Consumer verification binding.

acceptance.then: The Consumer is independently verified before the successful Replay Result is relied upon.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluates bindings for a successful Replay Result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or invalidate the independently bound Consumer verification from an otherwise successful replay receipt and require the semantic binding check to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful replay receipts to contain an independently verified Consumer binding rather than relying on a declared Consumer label.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Additive verification binding; receipts without a valid independent Consumer binding remain unsuccessful.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful Replay Result without independent Consumer verification -> successful Replay Result with independently bound Consumer verification.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A successful Replay Result is accepted only when its Consumer has a distinct, independently verified invocation binding.

acceptance.given: A Consumer route is invoked through its real repository call surface after its frozen manifest entry has been reconciled bidirectionally against that call surface.

oracle.expected: The resulting Consumer execution receipt binds values observed from that invocation for its interface, input, command, output, terminal result, and complete dependency identities.
forbidden: A Consumer receipt omits any actual interface, input, command, output, result, or dependency binding.
Declared Consumer metadata is accepted as execution binding without a matching observed invocation.
oracle.observable: The Consumer execution receipt and its manifest-to-call-surface reconciliation result.

acceptance.then: Every executed Consumer has complete actual-execution identity bindings.
acceptance.when: A Consumer route is executed or evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the Consumer receipt test with a manifest declaring complete fields while the route observation lacks a matching actual command, input, output, result, or dependency binding.
Validate an observed Consumer-route receipt after removing one required actual-execution binding.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Produce each Consumer receipt from the real Consumer invocation, binding observed interface, input, command, output, terminal result, and complete dependency identities; reject declaration-only or incomplete bindings while reconciling the frozen Consumer Manifest bidirectionally against VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing callers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing valid receipt fields retain their meanings; incomplete or declaration-only Consumer execution records fail closed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Consumer execution records may omit required actual-execution bindings -> every Consumer execution record contains complete actual-execution identity bindings.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: For every reconciled Consumer route invocation, its receipt contains observed interface, input identity, invoked command, output identity, terminal result, and dependency identities matching that invocation; any absent, declared-only, or mismatched binding fails closed.

acceptance.given: A repository-contained supported Toolchain Skill target has been requested for inspection.

oracle.expected: An independent execution witness binds observed opened/read target paths to the requested target identity and the resulting receipt.
forbidden: Accepting a target manifest or declared path without an observed effective read.
Relying on an inspection result whose observed target differs from the intended target.
oracle.observable: The instrumented target-read witness and its identity binding in the Toolchain inspection receipt.

acceptance.then: Effective inspection of the intended target is independently verified before the result is accepted or relied upon.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluates an inspection result before acceptance or reliance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use an instrumented inspection that reads a different target or emits no read witness and require acceptance to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind an independent observed-read witness to the requested target identity and reject inspection receipts without a matching effective-read observation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Receipt enrichment is additive; mismatched or absent effective-read witnesses fail closed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Requested target without independent effective-inspection proof -> requested target with a matching observed-read witness bound to its receipt.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No inspection result is accepted unless an independent observed-read witness establishes that the intended target was effectively inspected.
